svg.data-what: thyroid follicles: rings of follicular cells around stores of colloid

rect.data-what: the thin connective tissue between the follicles

g.data-what: capillaries wrapped around each follicle, taking the hormones away
the colloid filling each follicle: thyroglobulin, the protein the hormones are cut from, stored outside the cells
follicular cells, one layer around each follicle: they take up iodine, build thyroglobulin and release the thyroid hormones T3 and T4
parafollicular or C cells, pale, between the follicles: they make calcitonin
